# UC46 — Privilege A2A access review

**Track:** tools  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

Security analysts want to ask an agent to review access and follow how a delegated worker gathers evidence through Privilege-protected tools.

## PingOne Solution

A MainAgent delegates the analyst request to a WorkerAgent over A2A; the worker uses MCP through PingOne Privilege Gateway and returns an evidence-backed answer.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/privilege-mcp-client?view=demo&tab=a2a","label":"Open A2A access review"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `A2A_ACCESS_REVIEW`

## What to Say

> Send an access-review question in the A2A tab. The MainAgent delegates to the WorkerAgent, which gathers evidence through Privilege-protected MCP tools.
